tips.text: Infect a throwaway Adarza instead of your Smeeta; each Kavat gives only 3 imprints in its lifetime.
Skip the lure; wild Vasca are easy to find on the Plains at night.
Check your Kavat still has a free imprint slot before you take it out; a Kavat with all 3 spent gets infected but gives no Vasca imprint.
Check the Kavat is still glowing red before you apply the template; the infection can wear off.
Do not use Vasca Curative if you want the imprint; it only removes the glow.
Check the imprint's breed icon before you incubate; early imprints came out as the base breed.
Players call this an easy acquisition that mostly costs waiting on timers, about three days once you own a Kavat and have codes.
